newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains quiet and little changed.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains quiet and little changed.

text.p: UK cash grain prices were little changed on Monday in quiet trading.
"We are having one of our worst, worst days ever," said one broker.
No business was reported on the fob while brokers on the delivered market were having a very thin day.
Feed wheat traded in Suffolk/Essex at 97, 96.50 and 96 stg a tonne for Feb while in Liverpool 97.50 stg was paid for Feb.
Barley traded at 100 stg for Apr/Jun in East Anglia.
No milling wheat business was reported.
